newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Amic sees increased earnings in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Amic sees increased earnings in 1997.

text.p: South Africa's Anglo American Industrial Corp Ltd (Amic) said on Monday that it expected a real increase in earnings in the current year.
"A real increase in earnings is expected for 1997. Commodity markets are weak, but improving," the firm said in a statement with its year results.
Amic's earnings are heavily geared to world commodity prices and the value of the rand.
Earlier Amic posted a dip in earnings per share for the year to December 31, 1996, from 1,569 cents to 1,476 cents. It held its dividend at 545 cents a share.
Analysts polled by Reuters had forecast adjusted earnings per share in a 1,470 to 1,525 cents range with consensus at 1,498.75 cents per share.
They had ranged total dividend for the year between 545 cents and 560 cents per share with consensus at 552.5 cents.
